text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why Maya is gonna be 
Brian-san's bass teacher! You copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't answer with notes! And you're 
even hitting the string next to it!! 
You have to mute it, mute it!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! 
Brian, just accept what you can learn 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, looking good! 
Imagine hitting it powerfully, like 
*smack*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, I heard you only just started, but 
you're quite something. 
Hey, Mayano. Could you take a look at my 
guitar playing too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...? Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Thanks, Mayano. 
That phrase was giving me a hard time for 
a while.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome☆ 
.........

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama-san, doesn't that hurt? 
The skin on your fingers—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Ah, friction from the strings 
peeled off the skin. Don't worry, a 
scratch like this is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I want to polish everything to perfection. 
The theme of this year's Holy Hoof 
Festival is "Cheer for Everyone," right?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dormitory Umamusume
text_block_list.text: 『—Dorm Head!!』

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There are some girls I want to cheer on, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
『...I barely managed to win my Maiden 
race. Running any better than this... is 
just impossible for me...』

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's something I need to tell them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Something you want to tell them?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Autumn is a crucial season for 
Umamusume. They hit massive walls in major 
races, and the pressure is unreal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's painful, it's terrifying, and I know 
what it feels like when you just want to 
stop. ...Still, as Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —We run because we want to win, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna stoke that fire. Shake them 
to their core and make it surge through 
their veins. That primal drive that's 
pushed us far harder than any imagined 
future ever could.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Through our music, we'll deliver the 
thrill of racing. ...We'll make them want 
to chase that heat of battle and start 
running again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why playing like this just isn't 
good enough. Mind giving it another look?
(K-JAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! That's great! It's way tighter 
than this afternoon—wait, Mayano... hehe, 
what's with that look...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You got way too cool in just one day~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Weren't you just cheering me on a 
second ago?! You were giving me so much 
encouragement, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, but~... but still~...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, there are still some rough edges. 
Brian's improved so much that our parts 
are actually starting to clash in a 
distracting way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? The rhythm and 
pitch were spot-on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They were. But you've got way too much 
presence for a bassist. Instead of just 
laying the foundation... well, that's just 
the kind of Umamusume you are, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me to "yield" for the sake 
of the performance?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. —Let's just tear into 
each other as we are.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, feel free to play whatever you want 
during my guitar solo. And even then, my 
sound's gonna blow right past yours.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
H-Hishi Ama-san?! The solo is your big 
spotlight, you know?! Are you sure about 
that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's what makes it a real contest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've always known what kind of Umamusume 
Narita Brian is. Dazzling, frustrating, 
and unfairly cool.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So stay that way. Keep being that massive 
wall in front of me. Come on, let's play 
it again, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—...Fascinating. You're actually coming at 
me to "win"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and this time, it's your turn to get 
swallowed whole.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(—It's like their sounds are fighting each 
other. Crackling and sparking sparks all 
over...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Music like this actually exists... Even 
though they're playing the same song, 
they're both staying 100% true to 
themselves—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...I see. Maybe that's it! We don't have 
to change! I kept thinking we had to 
change, that I wanted them to change, 
but—!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya might've just figured it out...!
